key_facts: Family Dollar agreed to pay a $63 million settlement after federal and state authorities filed complaints for charging customers more than amounts advertised in mailers and displayed on store shelves.
According to the complaint filed by the FTC and 17 states, the retailer had overcharged shoppers "millions of dollars" since January 2023.
The order, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia, requires the company to create a "pricing accuracy program" to be independently certified annually.
Family Dollar neither admitted nor denied the allegations in the complaint.
importance_reason: Локальное корпоративное урегулирование с ограниченным рыночным эффектом; сумма небольшая для системного влияния.

key_facts: SpaceX successfully caught a Starship rocket, described by the source as a historic first.
The milestone brings SpaceX closer to "rapid reusability" of rockets.
importance_reason: Значимое техническое событие для космической отрасли, но без прямого рыночного эффекта на котируемые активы в тексте источника.

key_facts: The Starship spacecraft returned from orbit to the same spot where it lifted off.
The event is described as a key milestone in SpaceX's vision of building fully reusable rockets.
importance_reason: Технологическое событие без прямого рыночного эффекта; значимо для отрасли, но не для макро- или сырьевых рынков.

key_facts: Skims, the beauty brand of Kim Kardashian, offered refunds to all customers for its $148 (£110) advent calendar this week after widespread criticism on social media over the quality of its contents, including hair clips, scrunchies and keychains.
Beauty advent calendars often cost upwards of £100; Ipsos data shows around 15% of all advent calendars sold are beauty ones, with people aged 18-34 particularly willing to spend on them.
Heather Widdows, a philosophy professor and beauty expert, said it is exceptionally unlikely a buyer would use all the products inside a beauty calendar, so they are probably not worth it.
Julia spent £99 this year on a John Lewis fragrance calendar, which she considers good value, and plans to trade the items she doesn't want via a Facebook group.
importance_reason: Consumer-lifestyle feature without macro or market-moving content; only minor relevance to consumer spending trends.

key_facts: Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO after admitting an affair with Alice Huang, who ran Singaporean data centre company Megaspeed, a major Nvidia chip buyer; the suspected Chinese spy link is part of the same scandal.

Singapore was Nvidia's second-largest billing centre last year, accounting for nearly a fifth of its earnings, but less than 1% of earnings were for chips physically entering Singapore. US officials suspect Megaspeed gave Chinese companies backdoor access to Nvidia chips via data centres in Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand.

Singapore has charged four companies and five individuals, including Chinese nationals, for offences such as fraud linked to suspected purchases of Nvidia chips by DeepSeek; the investigation into Megaspeed, opened in February 2025, has produced no charges so far, and Alice Huang was allowed to leave Singapore in February 2026 after 'insufficient evidence' of crime was found.

Megaspeed's company was previously a 7Road subsidiary, renamed in March 2023 the day after Alice Huang was named executive director; she later transferred it to a Singaporean man, and critics describe the arrangement as 'Singapore-washing' of Chinese origins.
importance_reason: Скандал затрагивает контроль экспорта AI-чипов и роль Сингапура как хаба, но прямого рыночного шока пока нет; связанные расследования не завершены.
